name: Cellcom Israel Ltd.
summary: Cellcom Israel Ltd. is a leading provider of mobile telecommunications services throughout Israel. The company offers a wide array of services, encompassing internet access and core infrastructure, internet television, international and fixed-line voice telephony, and data transmission services tailored for both corporate clients and fellow telecommunications operators. Founded in 1994, Cellcom Israel Ltd. is headquartered in Netanya, Israel, and functions as a subsidiary of Discount Investment Corporation Ltd.
